clip.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 UGC-style fashion try-on video for social media, 15 seconds, four quick cuts, natural phone-camera look, bright warm apartment with wood floors, an arched mirror and soft daylight. The presenter is an AI-generated young adult woman (not any real person) with long brunette hair, friendly and excited, speaking English directly to the camera. The dress in every shot is the exact caramel-brown cable-knit midi sweater dress from the reference images: mock neck, ribbed waistband, long sleeves with ribbed cuffs, vertical cable-knit pattern down the skirt with a diagonal wrap seam, fitted through the hip, midi length, and a front slit. Keep its color, knit pattern, neckline, waistband and slit identical to the references.
Shot 1 (0-3 s): wearing a casual white tee, she holds the caramel dress on a hanger up to the camera and says: "Okay, you need to see this sweater dress."
Shot 2 (3-7 s): cut to her wearing the dress, mid-shot, smoothing the ribbed waist and turning slightly, saying: "It's cable knit, and it's fitted through the hips."
Shot 3 (7-11 s): cut to a full-length shot in black knee-high boots; she takes big confident steps that open the front slit, then does a little twirl, saying: "And the slit means you can actually walk in it."
Shot 4 (11-15 s): she walks up to the camera into a smiling close-up and says: "It comes in seven colors. Link's right here."
Clear natural speech, light room tone, no background music, no on-screen text, no logos.

qa.result: visual pass with minor flags; audio not verified
qa.notes: Seedance 2.0 Mini via OpenRouter, 15.10 s, 720x1280, 24 fps, AAC stereo 32 kHz. All 4 beats present: hanger (0-3 s), waist fit check (3-6 s), full-length walk in black boots opening the slit plus twirl (6-13 s), close-up (13-15 s). Caramel color, mock neck, ribbed waistband, plain bodice, cable skirt, diagonal wrap seam and front slit match, including on the hanger. Flags: boot height changes between knee-high and mid-calf across the walk; hip curve slightly exaggerated in the side/back view (~5-6 s). Same AI presenter throughout; no on-screen text or logos. Owner to listen to speech.
